title: Seoul police arrest ring accused of using AI to breach 90 organisations
summary: Police in Seoul have arrested seven people accused of using generative AI to break into about 90 organisations and steal 8.2 million records, the country's first large-scale AI-assisted hacking case. Investigators say 60 of the intrusions used AI tooling, including an autonomous penetration-testing system, and that 38 victims were then pressed for a combined 360 million won. The alleged ringleader was a self-taught hacker who had worked in simulated attacks.
